ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity central lobes; low-intensity pigmentation is mapped along the entire trailing edge and concentrated at the central hinge and distal tips. Two distinct dark focal spots are present on the upper-medial region of the right lobe, and a complex marbled pattern is mapped to the distal margin of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and frequent serrations across the entire trailing edge; amplitude of peaks and valleys increases significantly toward the outer distal regions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex sweep from the median notch that transitions into a slight concavity toward the sharp, upwardly-tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent, circular high-contrast dark clusters located in the upper-center of the right lobe; several smaller punctate dark marks are visible near the central notch area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned diagonal and vertical linear disruptions are visible across the high-intensity regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge contains numerous irregular nicks and jagged indentations, particularly on the outer lobes, indicating accumulated physical environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, high-contrast marbled pigmentation pattern located on the extreme distal portion of the left fluke lobe.
